{{Quote|My grandson Rica is underground.|Gueni|<ref name="TDOTD" />}}
'''Rica''' was the [[Gender/Legends|grandson]] of [[Gueni]], who lead the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] faction of the ongoing [[Melida/Daan Civil War]]<ref name="TDOTD" /> in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]'' to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].</ref> A member of [[the Young]], Rica fought alongside other like-minded youths to end the war, which had been fought between the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and Daan for so long that neither side could remember the initial cause.<ref name="TDOTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rica was mentioned the fifth novel of the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] young readers series, [[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead|''The Defenders of the Dead'']], written by [[Jude Watson]] and released in [[1999]].<ref name="TDOTD" />
